change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases c05, c07, c08, c09, n01 and n06 (four referenced, two native; none has run). You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier. Its prompt is the case row verbatim, the scenario registry path (apps/playground/src/scenarios/registry.tsx), the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and this fence: read only packages/basalt-ui/agent/**, packages/basalt-ui/llms.txt, the published subpaths' types and the playground's own code; never docs/v3/expression/**, docs/v3/evidence/ext-tuffui-devices.md, .claude/shots/**, docs/v3/cycles/** or any TuffUI source; import basalt-ui through published subpaths only; mark every workaround `// cycle-expression-2: <what the kit lacked>`; return the files written and a list of what it wanted from the kit or the skill and did not find. Run builders one after another or on disjoint files; each adds one registry entry. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts. (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case, never the builder. Its prompt is the case row, the shot paths, the scenario file paths, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md, and for a c case the reference shot from docs/v3/expression/references.md (re-take it from the URL there if the file is missing). Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `note` to that row.s brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md: confirmed, open or killed, one paragraph each, naming the number and the side it fell on. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts, or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Every `primitive` and `doctrine` fix row joins the `after` of v3-freeze-g4, and so does v3-cycle-expression-3 if such a P1 is open (EXPRESSION.md § Gate). Add two new cases to the bank from sources not used yet. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 1: (a) the reviewer cannot judge F7 and K3 from still shots; give it a keyboard-focused frame (focus the chart, press ArrowRight twice, shoot) for each case, or say in the cycle file why not; (b) a builder fenced to its own directory could not register a series group, so allow it one appended group in apps/playground/src/demo/series.ts and its provider wiring, and count it; (c) a case that needs a second fixture state has only `?shot-state=`; tell builders up front that `?fixture=<name>` read through the router is allowed.
